title: Chicken Pasanda
subtitle: A mild, creamy curry with almonds and aromatic whole spices
excerpt: Chicken thighs simmer in a smooth sauce of yoghurt, ground almonds, and cream with cardamom and mace. This is one of the gentler curries on the menu, with warmth that builds slowly.
sourceNotes: Anglo-Indian pasanda tradition derived from Mughal court cooking, adapted for the British curry-house menu.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze before adding the cream. Add the cream when reheating gently from frozen.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken overnight in the fridge for a deeper flavour. Cook the next day.

content.text: Pasanda is a mild curry built on a base of yoghurt and ground almonds, giving the sauce a velvety texture without much heat. The key step is marinating the chicken and not rushing the sauce once the yoghurt goes in, because high heat makes it split.
Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, ginger, garlic, and turmeric. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Heat the ghee in the large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the cardamom pods, cloves, and cinnamon stick and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Add the onions and cook for 10 minutes, stirring often, until golden. Add the ground coriander and cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato puree and ground almonds. Cook for 2 minutes until the paste smells nutty.
Add the marinated chicken along with all the marinade. Stir well. Pour in the stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook on a low heat for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thickened.
Stir in the cream, garam masala, and salt. Heat through without boiling. Taste and adjust seasoning.

items.symptom: The sauce has split and looks grainy.
items.cause: The yoghurt was added to a pan that was too hot, or the mixture boiled after the cream went in.
items.fix: Keep the heat low throughout. If it splits, add a splash of cold water and stir vigorously off the heat to bring it back.

items.cause: Not enough ground almonds, or the lid was on the whole time and steam built up.
items.fix: Cook uncovered for 10 more minutes to reduce, or stir in an extra tablespoon of ground almonds.

items.symptom: The whole spices are distracting in the finished dish.
items.cause: They were left in rather than picked out before serving.
items.fix: Remove the cinnamon stick and cardamom pods before serving. They flavour the oil but are not pleasant to eat.
